profile: Puma Biotechnology develops and commercializes products for cancer treatment. Its commercial product, NERLYNX, is an oral form of neratinib approved in the United States for certain early-stage and advanced or metastatic HER2-positive breast cancers. The company also holds global development and commercialization rights to alisertib, an investigational small-molecule inhibitor being developed initially for small cell lung cancer and hormone receptor-positive breast cancer.
